summary: Union County tower in the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest, first built in 1916 and rebuilt as an 82-ft timber tower with L-4 cab in 1954; still staffed in summer.

facts.design: L-4 cab on an 82-ft treated timber tower (1954)
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

access.note: Staffed in summer. A 2012 visitor was not invited up to the lookout. The site is listed as publicly accessible, which does not give access to the lookout itself. Road 6220 and the spur road were in very bad shape in 2012.

visit.trail_note: In 2012 the visitor parked at the base of the spur road and walked the last stretch. Road 6220 and the spur road were in very bad shape.

events.note: First lookout completed on a 50-ft tower with a fire-finder (NHLR); an August 1916 Morning Oregonian item reports the fire-finder being installed.
L-4 cab on a 30-ft pole tower, per NHLR and firelookout.com. Oregon Lookouts dates a new lookout to August 1930; the record's 1931 date follows the register.
Panorama photographs taken, per Oregon Lookouts.
Eugene Robinson listed as lookout personnel (firelookout.com).
82-ft treated timber tower with L-4 cab erected about one-eighth (firelookout.com) or one-quarter (Oregon Lookouts) mile east of the 1931 location.
Elton Thomas listed as lookout personnel (firelookout.com).
Visitor report says the lookout is staffed in summer.

corrections.why: The 9.1 m (30 ft) height belongs to the 1931 pole tower. The present tower, built in 1954, is 82 ft (about 25 m) per NHLR and firelookout.com.

corrections.proposed: L-4 cab on an 82-ft treated timber tower (1954); the L-4 on a 30-ft pole tower (1931) was its predecessor
corrections.why: The record's L-4 describes the cab only and matches the 1931 structure's height, not the standing 1954 tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and firelookout.com date the L-4 cab on a 30-ft pole tower to 1931; Oregon Lookouts records a new lookout completed in August 1930. The record keeps 1931 per the register and firelookout.com.
firelookout.com says one-eighth mile east of the 1931 location; Oregon Lookouts says about one-fourth mile east of the original tower. Story says only 'a short distance'.

notes_for_editor: Staffing (seasonal, as_of 2012) rests on firelookout.com's undated 'staffed every summer', a 2012 visit report and an undated standing-lookouts list; no Forest Service source found. Access 'restricted' is inferred from the staffed cab and a 2012 visitor not being invited up; the road's current condition is unverified. Two record corrections: height_m 9.1 is the 1931 pole tower, and design 'L-4' omits the 82-ft tower. Omitted on purpose: a 1961 fatal fall from this tower, reported in a Bend Bulletin item quoted by Oregon Lookouts; it is not part of the lookout's fire-watch history, so the editor may want to decide whether to add it. Elevation: register 6,710 ft and the record's 2045.2 m agree; firelookout.com and the standing-lookouts list give 6,745 ft.
